subject: general
question: The currency of Malaysia is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ringgit.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Malaysian Ringgit** is the **currency of Malaysia.**
 
• It is divided into **100 Sen**, so that **100 Sen= 1 Ringgit **(similar to 100 Paise= 1 Rupee). 
 
• The ringgit is issued by the** Central Bank of Malaysia. **
